version.changelog:
No changes detected for version 1.1.0.

- No file or documentation updates were made in this release.
- Functionality, workflow, and usage instructions remain unchanged.

llm.summary: This appears to be a transparent deep-research workflow; the main thing to notice is its intentionally high-volume web and PDF research behavior, not hidden credential, persistence, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and visible instructions are coherent: the skill plans research, searches the web, extracts web/PDF content, verifies sources, and writes cited reports. This is sensitive mainly because it can perform broad external research activity.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs autonomous iterative research with 100+ sources and up to 10 concurrent searches. This is purpose-aligned, but users should set time, cost, source, and scope limits when invoking it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, no required binaries, and no required environment variables. The included scripts are packaging/validation utilities and are not shown as automatically executed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: External web and PDF retrieval is proportionate to a deep-research agent, but it may send user research topics to search/content providers and generate substantial network activity.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The provided artifacts do not show credentials, local auth/session access, persistent memory, background agents, privilege escalation, or destructive local/system operations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill looks suitable for user-invoked deep research, but expect it to perform many external searches and content extractions. Before using it, define the topic, source limits, and whether sensitive or confidential research topics should be avoided.

evidence.explanation: The skill explicitly directs high-volume autonomous use of web search and content extraction tools. This is aligned with deep research, but it can consume time/quota and expose research topics to external services.
evidence.snippet: Tools Used: `batch_web_search`, `extract_content_from_websites` ... Target: Minimum 100 unique, verified sources ... Run independent searches in parallel (up to 10 concurrent queries)

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it with clear topic boundaries, source exclusions if needed, and any desired limits on time, number of sources, or external searches.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Invoking the skill may cause many web searches and page/PDF fetches for a single request.

evidence.explanation: The registry metadata does not provide an upstream source or homepage, which limits independent provenance review. The risk is reduced because no install mechanism or suspicious code behavior is shown.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the visible files and publisher information before installing, especially because the provided SKILL.md excerpt is marked truncated in the scan context.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: It may be harder to verify who maintains the skill or compare it against an upstream repository.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill has disclosed high-volume autonomous web research behavior and limited provenance metadata, but no evidence of hidden execution, destructive actions, or deception.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account access, elevated privileges, or local auth/session stores are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No broad local indexing, persistent memory, inter-agent data sharing, or sensitive local data handling is shown.
